Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning hunting-related enforcement actions involving tribal members.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to hunting-related enforcement actions involvingtribal members; and adding a new section to chapter 77.15 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon presentation of a tribal identification card by a member of afederally recognized tribe to a fish and wildlife officer or ex officiofish and wildlife officer, the officer must immediately refer anyinspection, investigation, or other enforcement action related to thehunting activity of the tribal member to the enforcement authority ofthe tribe, if the activity occurred on any open and unclaimed landswhere the tribe has a treaty right to hunt.
